entities.summary: Giuseppe Ferlini was an Italian adventurer and archaeologist. A pioneer archaeologist of Kushite antiquities, he is best known for his discovery of the treasure of Queen Amanishakheto in 1834. Ferlini's archaeological methods have been criticized for focusing on treasure retrieval over scientific, contextual documentation, and for badly damaging the pyramids of Meroë.
